item.description: One of Jaylen McClain’s first actions after Ohio State’s Big Ten Championship Game loss to Indiana was to hit up Target. Not for himself, but for children in Columbus. He bought toys for boys and girls of all ages to donate to the Salvation Army of Central Ohio’s Christmas Cheer toy distribution. item.title: Ohio State Lands Four-Star Linebacker Quinton Cypher for Class of 2027
item.description: James Laurinaitis is on the board in the class of 2027. Four-star linebacker Quinton Cypher, the No. 192 overall prospect and No. 11 linebacker in the current junior class, committed to Ohio State over fellow finalists Alabama, Miami and Georgia on Friday. Cypher hails from Raleigh, North Carolina, where he's a tackle machine for Millbrook High School. item.title: Ohio State Favored By Slightly More Than A Touchdown Against Both Texas A&M and Miami
item.description: Ohio State is favored to win the Cotton Bowl by slightly more than a touchdown – regardless of who wins Saturday’s first-round game between Texas A&M and Miami. Per FanDuel Sportsbook, Ohio State is a 7.5-point favorite over Texas A&M and an 8.5-point favorite over Miami ahead of Saturday’s first-round game (Noon, ABC/ESPN) between the Aggies and Hurricanes, which will determine who the Buckeyes play in the College Football Playoff quarterfinal at the Cotton Bowl (Dec. 31, 7:30 p.m., ESPN).
